system.description: YANG OF THUGS PARTY, CRIMINAL, INFAMOUS PARTY TENSION METER All party members suffer 1 stress and 1 fatigue. All party members suffer 1 wound, then tension resets to zero as the gang leader cracks heads LEGBREAKERS Once per session, a party member may spend 1 {Df} to grant all party members +1 damage to all attacks (including brawl) for 1 round for each {Df} used to fuel this tactic.
